items.garbagetw: A single Taiwanese city garbage truck: a short white cab at the front and a big bright yellow rounded compactor body behind it, at the very back a wide open loading hopper with a dark opening where people throw rubbish bags, a small grey loudspeaker horn on top of the cab, orange warning lights, black tyres with silver hubs, a worker in an orange safety vest standing on the rear step
